personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK fused with 7 Dark-First Utility
personality_one_liner: A deeply elegant, cinematic command center—like a high-end audio journal—that treats file downloading and media conversion with editorial reverence.

spacing.rule: Generous, editorial spacing. Let components breathe like an art gallery. Use md (12) for inner elements and xl (24) for macro layout.

do's: Use heavily blurred glass (expo-blur) over the abstract hero texture on the Home tab.
Apply glass to the bottom tab bar and sticky headers.
Use glass for the floating playback controls overlaying album/video art on the Player screen.
Always underlay glass with a minimum 75% surface color tint to ensure typography remains perfectly readable.
dont's: Never apply glass to standard list items, form inputs, or dense queue metric cards.
Never use glass without an underlying tint layer.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A cinematic URL resolver that feels like entering a premium studio space.

states.loading: A glowing amber ring spinner centered on the dark canvas.
states.empty: An elegant tinted illustration with 'Awaiting your first media link.'
states.error: Soft error toast with a retry button inside a glassmorphic container.

screens.layout: Top half is a hero section featuring a dark, textured cinematic background image. Overlaid is a glassmorphic card housing a sleek URL input field (pill-shaped, brand primary cursor/focus ring) and a Paste button. The bottom half transitions to a solid surface displaying 'Recent Sources' in a 2-column grid with subtle brandTertiary icons.

screens.name: Queue
screens.purpose: A highly readable, tactical command center for active and completed downloads.

states.loading: Skeleton rows echoing the progress bars.
states.empty: A minimalist dust-particle background texture fading into the dark surface, with 'Queue is silent.'
states.error: A highlighted card showing failed downloads with a one-tap retry.

screens.layout: Strict list layout. Each active download card uses surfaceSecondary with a thin 0.5pt border. Progress bars are extremely thin (2-3pt) using brandPrimary (Gold) on a surfaceTertiary track. Actions (Pause/Resume/Cancel) are housed in a muted right-aligned block. Speed and ETA metrics use a monospace or tightly tracked Satoshi.

screens.name: Library
screens.purpose: A gallery showcasing saved media, focusing on rich album/video art.

states.empty: An elegant empty state with 'Your vault is empty.' and a CTA to explore.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header with a search bar and segmented control (Grid / List). The main area is a 2-column grid. Every media thumbnail MUST have a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse) to guarantee contrast for the overlaid title (in Fraunces) and duration pill.

screens.name: Player

states.loading: Blurred artwork background with a central spinner.
states.empty: N/A - Player only pushed with valid media.
states.error: Fallback artwork with 'Unable to play media.'

screens.layout: Full-bleed artwork covering the entire screen. A heavy vertical gradient scrim (transparent at top, transitioning to 90% surface at bottom) overlays the image. The title sits in the bottom third using Fraunces (xl or 2xl). Playback controls (Play, Seek, Skip) sit inside a sleek, pill-shaped glassmorphic floating bar near the bottom safe area.

screens.name: Tools (Audio Studio)
screens.purpose: An elegant conversion interface treating files like high-end audio gear.

states.empty: Select a file to begin conversion.

screens.layout: List-based settings interface. Features tactile, pill-shaped segmented controls for Format (MP3/M4A/OPUS) and Bitrate. Uses brandTertiary backgrounds for active selections to feel like illuminated studio buttons.

home_hero_bg.alt: Mystical floating dust particles creating a dark, cinematic textured background

empty_state_texture.alt: Abstract black and white architectural lines for subtle structural background

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Absolutely ZERO blues, purples, navies, or cyan gradients are allowed. Use the provided Smoked Espresso (Dark Charcoal) and Antique Gold palette.
Implement the elegant Fraunces serif font for display headers and media titles. This provides the requested 'unique twist' to distinguish it from generic Dribbble utility apps.
Ensure all images and thumbnails implement the MANDATORY vertical gradient scrim (transparent to >= 70% dark tint) before placing text on them.
Apply glassmorphism (blur over tint) to the bottom tab bar, sticky headers, and the home screen URL resolver card over the hero background.
For the Queue screen, prioritize tactical utility: keep progress bars thin and elegant (2pt), and use monospace-style layout for speed/ETA metrics.
Make the media player edge-to-edge, hiding the standard system header and allowing the artwork and glass controls to take center stage.
